## AspectFrame.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `ratio` :: The width-to-height proportion of the frame.
- `fit` :: How the media inside fits the frame: cover crops, contain letterboxes, fill stretches, scale-down never enlarges.
- `shape` :: The corner shape. The frame clips its media to the shape.
- `children` :: The media. Receives the class to put on the img or video, which fills the frame and applies the fit.
